subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in silent STT history-enrichment mode for unmentioned Discord audio in requireMention channels, and should that mode be Discord-specific or a shared channel contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but retaining unmentioned speech in later model context changes privacy/security expectations and adds config surface that repository policy treats as maintainer-owned direction.

options.title: Shared opt-in channel contract
options.body: Define a generic channel-history enrichment contract for silent audio transcription and implement Discord as the first supported channel with security/provenance tests.

options.title: Discord-only option
options.body: Add a narrow Discord guild/channel option first, accepting later migration risk if other channels need the same behavior.

options.title: Decline silent retention
options.body: Keep current mention-gated behavior and document that unmentioned audio is not transcribed into later history.

recommendation.title: Shared opt-in channel contract
recommendation.body: Define a generic channel-history enrichment contract for silent audio transcription and implement Discord as the first supported channel with security/provenance tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest current-main routing candidate for the exact Discord preflight/history files in the available checkout history.
